diagnosis.what_happened: Agents wrote temporary analysis and test scripts directly into repository root folders.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Agents defaulted to the current working directory when generating helper or test scripts, causing top-level directory clutter.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Agents must route scripts to canonical destinations: scratch directory, 02_analysis_code, .agents/scripts, or tests.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Repository root must remain clean and standard. Project scripts belong in 02_analysis_code and scratch scripts in the designated session scratch path.

desired_behavior: Never write scripts directly into the repository root. Always route scripts to 02_analysis_code/ for project analysis, .agents/scripts/ for suite tools, tests/ for tests, or the session scratch directory.
generalization: Enforce clean root taxonomy across all projects and agents. Root directory is reserved for repository configuration, documentation, and declared entry points.

evidence.observed_value: User flagged annoying script generation in root directory.
evidence.threshold_value: Zero unwhitelisted scripts in repository root.
